thread:
Maya Patel: Heads up — we're consolidating Capacity + Runtime into a single team called Platform Performance reporting into Priya. Ethan Zhou will step in as Senior Eng Manager for the new team effective 2025-04-14. This aligns ownership for batching, KV cache, autoscaling and model routing. We'll keep existing oncall rotation for now. Two backfills approved: Staff SRE (runtime infra) and Sr SW Eng (batching/compilation). Leah will post reqs tomorrow. Please update team pages/org charts and join the AMA Thurs 10:00. @Ethan @Leah

Ethan Zhou: Really excited to take this on. Thanks Maya and team. I'll schedule 1:1s with leads next week.

Rajiv Menon: Congrats Ethan! Quick q — will Dedicated infra still route through Platform infra or is that a separate reporting line? cc @Priya

Kara Li: :tada: congrats. For the Staff SRE req do we have an interview loop ready or should recruiting draft a starter loop?

Leah Kim: I'll post the req + hiring rubric by EOD tomorrow and spin up an interview-panel thread. Recruiting will own initial screens and scheduling.

people-ops-bot: Maya Patel added event "Platform Performance AMA" to calendar Thu 10:00-10:30 — attendees: all@company

Priya Natarajan: Thanks Maya — the alignment makes sense. We'll keep SLA targets unchanged and share a rollout checklist in docs by COB Fri.

Alex Gomez: Is there any immediate change to oncall escalation? Our rotation might need an extra headcount if we inherit more surface area.

Maya Patel: No immediate oncall changes — we'll reassess after two sprints. If teams need interim coverage, DM me and we'll coordinate.

Kara Li: will do. looping in eng-sre and eng-runtime channels for visibility: @eng-sre @eng-runtime

Ethan Zhou: Can someone grant me access to the dedicated capacity dashboards and SLO dashboards? @eng-infra

Samira Ahmed: I can add you — Ethan, send me the list of dashboards and I'll grant access today.

Leah Kim: Recruiting note: target hire timeline is 6–8 weeks from post. If any role needs a faster timeline, flag now.

Priya Natarajan: One ask — team leads please update your team pages and oncall docs by EOD Friday so we have up-to-date runbooks for the handoff.

Maya Patel: Thanks everyone — big change but good outcome for product velocity. Ping me with any questions and bring items to the AMA if you want a public discussion.
